collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official Command Code GOAT pages (English) around 10:30 Beijing time / 02:30Z on 2026-10-31: the GOAT plan page, the public pricing page and the pricing-limits resource page, read as published, and compared line-by-line against the same three pages captured on 2026-10-30. Both the rendered text diff and the embedded RSC payload diff (budgetUsd / rates / budgetSteps / shape / timeOfDay per model) were checked. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed.
scope: Command Code GOAT official pages only. Two per-model allowance increases on the boosted-credit deals: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM-5.3 Flash, both GOAT $80 -> $100 and Pro $90 -> $110 (Go stays $10), with the embedded RSC budgetUsd moved 80 -> 100 for the same two models and rates / budgetSteps / shape / timeOfDay unchanged. The DeepSeek deal wording lost its 'no end date' statement and no new end date was written; the GLM deal keeps 'while capacity lasts'. The official per-model request estimates on the plan page moved accordingly. Additionally a new free limited-time model 'Ling 3.1 Flash 1019' appeared and the daily request cap of the free 'Glyph Cluster:free' model went 100 -> 1000 requests/day. The GOAT shared-pool wording ('Up to $100') did not change and the other 57 GOAT models keep the same budgetUsd / rates / budgetSteps. No leaderboard/score data, no OpenCode Go rows touched, no other channel's rows touched, no adopted.csv row.

interpretation.summary: On 2026-10-31 the two boosted-credit deals on the Command Code GOAT plan were raised from $80 to $100 on GOAT (and $90 to $110 on Pro, with Go unchanged at $10): DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM-5.3 Flash. The embedded RSC payload moved budgetUsd 80 -> 100 for exactly those two models and left rates, budgetSteps, request shape and timeOfDay untouched. The official 'Estimated requests' rows on the plan page moved in step (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (latest) 41,000/103,000/205,000 -> 51,300/128,000/256,000; GLM-5.3 Flash 9,440/23,600/47,200 -> 11,800/29,500/59,000).

wordingChange.statement: The DeepSeek deal lost its end-date statement: 'Ends: no end date' and the 'with no end date' line were deleted and no new end date was written, while the marketing sentence became 'DeepSeek V4.1 Flash comes with bigger monthly credits.' The GLM deal is unchanged in wording and still reads 'while capacity lasts'.
wordingChange.basis: pricing-limits page text diff and the 2026-10-31 deal blocks for both models.

ambiguity.statement: The pages do not state whether the DeepSeek $100 boost is permanent or time-limited. Previously the deal explicitly said 'with no end date' / 'permanently boosted'; now the term is simply absent. Whether the silence means 'permanent' or 'term not disclosed' cannot be settled from the captured pages.
supportingFacts: The DeepSeek deal block on 2026-10-31 has no 'Term' or 'Ends' row at all, while the GLM deal still has 'Term: while capacity lasts'.
The DeepSeek 'Credits' row still shows the same $10 Go · $100 GOAT · $110 Pro figures with no expiry attached.
The RSC payload carries no time bound on budgetUsd for either model.

repoPipeline.note: This capture does not change the pipeline. The two adopted command_code_goat rows keep their recorded $80 allowance, and the effective value stays min($70 shared pool, allowance). Whether the observed $100 allowance should be carried into the adopted rows is left to maintainer review.

interpretation.notComputed: This file changes no adopted value, no shared-pool constant and no script, and computes no monthlyYi, no blended per-MTok price, no effective min() value and no request counts of its own. All dollar figures and request estimates are transcribed as published on the official pages.

unchangedScope: Only DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM-5.3 Flash changed their per-model allowance; the other 57 GOAT models keep the same budgetUsd / rates / budgetSteps.
No per-token rate changed for any GOAT model (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash $0.003/$0.15/$0.60 off-peak with peak 2x; GLM-5.3 Flash $0.03/$0.15/$0.50).
No budgetSteps value changed (null for both models, before and after).
No GOAT model was removed from the plan; the only catalog addition is the free 'Ling 3.1 Flash 1019'.
The GOAT shared-pool wording 'Up to $100' did not change.
No leaderboard or score data touched.
No adopted.csv row touched; scripts/build_adopted.py still records $80 for deepseek-v4.1-flash and glm-5.3-flash.
computationNote: No monthlyYi, no blended per-MTok price, no effective min() value and no adopted value are computed in this file; all dollar figures and request estimates are transcribed as published on the official pages.
confidenceNote: The allowance figures, the RSC payload values and the request estimates are official and internally consistent across the three pages. Confidence is not 'high' because the DeepSeek deal no longer states any term: it is not possible to tell from the pages whether the $100 boost is permanent or merely of unstated duration, and the community report in Issue #171 is not an official source.
